storyCards.fact:
Craig Mack's "Flava In Ya Ear" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 25 weeks on the chart.

Flava In Ya Ear was released in 1994.
